attributes.name: Most High Ceoptra
attributes.powers:
Succeed at an Arcane or Divine 15 check or you may not play spells with the Attack trait.

Damage dealt by Most High Ceoptra causes cards to be buried instead of discarded. This damage may not be reduced.

"You have come far and done much, and for that you should be rewarded. Come, die an honored death before the throne of our master."—Most High Ceoptra, lamia harridan
